title: Te Hapori i Whakahē i te Rā Okiokinga
intro: Eke atu ki tētahi kāinga takutai moana i reira i whakaritea ai e te ture atua tētahi rā mō te karakia me te pupuri i te mana. I whiriwhiria e tētahi rōpū i roto i tēnei hapori te whakamātautau i ngā rohe o taua ture mā te whakamahi i tētahi mahere tinihanga, ā, ka arahina atu ki tētahi panonitanga ka rangona i roto i ngā tau. Ko wai ēnei wairua, ā, i pēhea rātou?
clues: I noho mātou i te taha o te takutai moana, ā, ko te moana te wāhi i ora ai mātou.
I whakahaua mai ki a tātou kia whakahonore i tētahi rā o te wiki, kia waiho i te taha o ngā mahi o te ao.
I taua rā, i haere mai te ika ki a mātou he tini, me te mea nei kei te whakamatautauria mātou kia takahi i te whakahau.
I whakatakoto mātou i tētahi mahere hei hopu i ngā ika i te ahiahi o te rā tapu, kātahi ka kohikohi i a rātou ina pahemo.
I te whakatūpato a ētahi o mātou kia kaua e tinihanga, ka wareware mātou ki tā rātou tohutohu, ka tohe tonu.
Mō ā mātou hara, i whakaputaia ketia mātou hei makimaki, i whakahaweatia, i whakakahoretia.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
